recipe.visualDefinition: A studio-lit full-body portrait of a five-member ensemble standing in a staggered line against a neutral grey gradient background. The subjects are styled in Y2K-era fashion featuring metallic, mesh, and monochromatic textures. A prominent graphic symbol acts as a central divider for the wide-spaced sans-serif typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Staggered horizontal alignment of figures creating depth
High-contrast monochromatic clothing against a mid-tone grey backdrop
Symmetrical typographic header balanced by a central geometric icon
Direct eye contact from all subjects to engage the viewer
coreInvariants: Neutral grey studio background with soft floor shadows
High-key studio lighting with soft highlights on skin and hair

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five full-body figures occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled to fill the width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in white and the red icon directly above her head.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central red icon, moves outward to the text, then scans the individual figures from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space in the upper third for typography and around the feet to ground the subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral grey and white for the background and core lighting.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and charcoal in the clothing to provide silhouette definition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the central graphic icon.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subjects' clothing and the background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both sides of the central icon to maintain symmetry.
graphicDevices: Central geometric star icon with a soft glow effect

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the wide, square-ish geometric feel of the era.
Provides the clean geometric curves and thin strokes.
Matches the tech-forward, wide-set aesthetic of early 2000s pop.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of five diverse women in Y2K fashion (mesh tops, low-rise pants, metallic textures) standing in a line against a clean grey gradient background. Use high-key lighting and leave the top 25% of the frame empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of text at the top using a light geometric sans-serif font with extreme tracking. Place a red 6-pointed star icon in the exact center of the text line.

verificationChecks: Is the tracking wide enough to span the width of the image?
Is the red icon perfectly centered between the two text blocks?
Are the subjects' outfits consistent with Y2K monochromatic styling?

adjustableVariables: Specific Y2K clothing textures (leather vs mesh)
postGenerationChecks: Check for five distinct figures with clear separation
Ensure text is legible despite the extreme tracking
Verify the red icon is the only high-saturation element
Confirm the background is a smooth, artifact-free grey gradient
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a multi-subject studio portrait in monochromatic Y2K styling with a top-aligned, ultra-wide-tracked geometric sans-serif header split by a single saturated accent icon.
